sources.twoWayMethods: ACI 318-19 8.2.1, 8.4.1.2: two-way slabs by the direct design method (8.10) or the equivalent frame method (8.11) for gravity loads
sources.directDesign.limits: ACI 318-19 8.10.2.1-8.10.2.7, Eq 8.10.2.7b: three spans, panels at most 2 : 1, spans within one third, column offsets 10 %, L <= 2D, 0.2 <= αf1 l2² / αf2 l1² <= 5
sources.directDesign.distribution: ACI 318-19 8.10.4.1, Table 8.10.4.2: 0.65 / 0.35 in interior spans and the end span shares
sources.directDesign.transfer: ACI 318-19 8.10.7.3: 0.3 Mo to an edge column; 8.10.7.2 Eq 8.10.7.2: Msc = 0.07 [(qDu + 0.5 qLu) l2 ln² - qDu' l2' ln'²]

sources.corner: ACI 318-19 8.7.3.1: top and bottom steel at exterior corners for the largest positive moment over l/5 with edge walls or αf > 1
sources.openings: ACI 318-19 8.5.4.1-8.5.4.2: openings in slabs without beams
